notes.title: Update Alpha 1.2.0
notes.content:
We published a new update yesterday, This update brings many more new features to the game.
Let's talk about these:

When you break a tree it doesn't vanish suddenly now. Instead it is really falling down.
Killing npcs gives you xp too. (Less than killing a player of course)
New Inventory System
A bug that causing stamina runs out so fast has been fixed.
Some npc ai improvements

We were using a different type of inventory system, however it was a little bit confusing. So we switched to a standart system.
We are waiting for your feedbacks.

Have a nice day.

notes.title: Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we didn't publish a new update for long time. The reason was that we were working on a bigger update. We will publish a new update soon(still in development) and this update will be bigger than previous ones. Now let's talk about what is new.

First change is about ingame gui, specially people found inventory system and it's design a bit confusing and uneffective. So we changed inventory system to a standart look. also made changes in design.

We have a couple of new mechanics like inventory weight and weather heatrow.

Fixed some bugs, these are:
Npc health is visible far away.
Stamina goes down extremely fast depending on game fps.

Some other features:
Online players list in server
Trees are now destroying rather than dissappearing suddenly.

We will also reduce the game price before the update so everyone can play it.
If you have any suggestions or want to report a bug, comment on this post.

notes.title: Map Redesign And Optimization Update
notes.content:
Our last update brings new map, better optimization and waters.
Map is larger now and has a more island-feel look.
We also added new physics like swimming and animations look better now.

If you find a bug or missing feature, we have a feedback option in the main menu that can help you to contact with us.

Have a nice day.
